title: Test-Time Self-Play: Scaling without a Verifier
abstract: arXiv:2611.07367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time scaling methods spend additional compute at deployment to improve a large language model's performance on a hard target problem. Most methods rely on a verifier that scores candidate solutions for correctness, using it to select among or refine the model's outputs. In many deployment regimes, however, a strong verifier on the target problem is unavailable. We introduce Test-Time Self-Play (TTSP), an approach to test-time scaling using asymmetric self-play without reliance on a verifier. On a difficulty-calibrated subset of LiveCodeBench v6, TTSP is the best-performing method at every verifier strength we evaluate, and the gap to the strongest baseline widens as the verifier weakens; in the no-verifier limit, TTSP yields a 35\% absolute improvement in mean@8. The gains hold across a range of verifier strengths, except when the base policy has near-zero coverage of the correct answer.

translated_title: 测试时自我博弈：无需验证器的扩展方法
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展方法在部署阶段投入额外的计算资源，以提升大语言模型在困难目标问题上的性能。大多数方法依赖于一个验证器来对候选解决方案的正确性进行评分，并利用它来选择或改进模型的输出。然而，在许多部署场景中，针对目标问题的强验证器往往是不可用的。我们提出了测试时自我博弈（Test-Time Self-Play, TTSP），这是一种利用非对称自我博弈、无需依赖验证器的测试时扩展方法。在 LiveCodeBench v6 的难度校准子集上，TTSP 在我们评估的每一种验证器强度下都是表现最佳的方法，并且随着验证器强度的减弱，它与最强基线之间的差距不断扩大；在无验证器的极限情况下，TTSP 在 mean@8 指标上带来了 35% 的绝对提升。这些收益在各种验证器强度下均能保持，除非基础策略对正确答案的覆盖率接近于零。
tldr: 该论文提出测试时自我博弈（TTSP），一种基于非对称自我博弈、无需验证器的测试时扩展方法，在无验证器的情况下于 LiveCodeBench v6 上实现了 mean@8 提升 35% 的绝对改进，且验证器越弱其优势越明显。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Test-Time Self-Play (TTSP), a verifier-free test-time scaling method based on asymmetric self-play, which achieves a 35% absolute improvement in mean@8 on LiveCodeBench v6 in the no-verifier setting, with its advantage widening as verifiers become weaker.
